name: Meera's Eggless Bakes
tagline: Fresh eggless cakes and cupcakes from Baner, Pune
about: I'm Meera, and I bake eggless cakes and cupcakes in my home kitchen in Baner, Pune. I started 3 years back for friends and family, and now we take orders from all over Pune. Everything is made fresh to order with no preservatives, using real butter and Belgian chocolate. Custom birthday and anniversary cakes with photo print or theme toppers are also possible.
hours: Open 10am to 8pm, closed on Tuesdays. Please order at least 2 days before. Orders mostly on WhatsApp.
